traps.question: Select the correct simple past tense sentence:
options: Yesterday I went to the store.
Yesterday I did went to the store.
Yesterday I was go to the store.
Yesterday I goed to the store.
traps.explanation: Simple past uses the V2 form directly without 'did' in positive statements: 'I went to the store.'
traps.ruleHint: Positive Past: Subject + V2 (went), never 'did went'.

traps.question: What is the correct past tense of the verb 'buy'?
traps.ruleHint: Irregular Verbs: Buy -> Bought | Bring -> Brought.

traps.question: Which sentence correctly describes an action completed last night?
options: I written an email last night.
I wrote an email last night.
I did wrote an email last night.
I was wrote an email last night.
traps.explanation: The V2 simple past of 'write' is 'wrote': 'I wrote an email last night.'
